title: MEDIA arm of the MUSLIM COUNCIL OF BRITAIN exposed for pressuring news outlets to whitewash less than flattering stories about Islam and Muslims
text: MEDIA arm of the MUSLIM COUNCIL OF BRITAIN exposed for pressuring news outlets to whitewash less than flattering stories about Islam and Muslims July 10, 2025 by BareNakedIslam Leave a Comment The Centre for Media Monitoring (CfMM), as part of the Muslim Council of Britain, in its efforts to ‘control the narrative’ about Muslims, has succeeded in censoring/suppressing many negative but factual stories about Islamic grooming gangs, terrorists, child rapists, criminals, etc, as part of its wider campaign to impose legal restrictions on what the media can and can’t say about Islam. In essence, trying to impose a form of blasphemy law on non-Muslims. This follows CfMM’s defamatory and libelous report about GB News, the one media outlet that refuses to submit to threats and pressure by Muslim groups to eliminate or limit the number of negative stories coming out about their community.
